info.name: SIP Analyzer Service
info.description:
End-to-end test suite for sip-analyzer-service.

## How to run, step by step
1. Start the service: `mvn spring-boot:run` (port 8080).
2. Import this collection and `SIP-Analyzer.postman_environment.json`; select the *SIP Analyzer - Local* environment.
3. Run **0.1** to confirm connectivity.
4. Open the collection **Runner**, keep the default order, click *Run*. Expect all tests green.
5. Or from a terminal: `newman run SIP-Analyzer.postman_collection.json -e SIP-Analyzer.postman_environment.json`.

Each request's *Description* explains what it checks and the expected numbers; the *Tests* tab holds the assertions.

item.name: 0. Smoke Test
item.description: Confirm the service is running before running anything else.

request.description:
**Step 1:** Start the app: `mvn spring-boot:run`.
**Step 2:** Send this GET request.
**Step 3:** Expect **200** and an OpenAPI JSON listing all 6 endpoints.

If it fails with *Could not get response*, the service is not running on `{{baseUrl}}`.

exec: pm.test('corpus = invested + gain for every row', () => j.yearlySchedule.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.finalCorpus).to.be.closeTo(r.totalInvested + r.wealthGain, 0.02)));

**Step 4:** `milestones` defaults to years 5, 10, 15, 20.
**Step 5:** Year-10 corpus must be about **2,323,390.76** (hand-calculated: 10000 x 230.0387 x 1.01); total invested 1,200,000.
**Step 6:** Every row must satisfy `finalCorpus = totalInvested + wealthGain`.

**Step 1:** Send the request; milestones are deliberately unsorted with a duplicate.
**Step 2:** Expect **200**.
**Step 3:** `milestones` must be de-duplicated and sorted: 7, 12, 25 (independent of `years`=3).
**Step 4:** `yearlySchedule` has only 3 rows.

**Step 1:** Send with 0% return (division-by-zero edge case in the formula).
**Step 2:** Expect **200**; year-2 corpus = 5000 x 24 = **120,000** and wealthGain = 0.

item.name: 2. Step-Up SIP
item.description: Module 2: Standard vs annual step-up SIP.

request.description:
**Step 1:** Send (10,000/month, 12%, 20y, +10% each year).
**Step 2:** Expect **200**.
**Step 3:** Standard corpus ~ **9,991,479.19**; step-up corpus ~ **19,888,715.49**; step-up invested ~ **6,872,999.94**.
**Step 4:** Year 2 monthly SIP in `stepUpSchedule` = 11,000 and year 3 = 12,100.
**Step 5:** `delta` values must equal step-up minus standard.

**Step 1:** Send with `stepUpPercent: 0` - the simulation engine must reproduce the closed-form formula.
**Step 2:** Expect **200**; `delta.additionalCorpus` ~ 0 and `additionalInvestment` = 0.

**Step 1:** Omit `stepUpPercent`.
**Step 2:** Expect **400** with `errors.stepUpPercent`.

**Step 2:** Send the request (body is `{{rollingBody}}`).
**Step 3:** Expect **200**.
**Step 4:** 3y window: **37** observations, average ~ 12.68% ((1.01^12 - 1) x 100), 100% outperform benchmark. 5y window: **13** observations.
**Step 5:** Max drawdown is 0 (monotonic series). Trailing returns for 1y, 3y, 5y present (7y/10y absent - history too short).

item.name: 4. Active vs Passive
item.description: Module 4. Net return = gross - TER. Defaults: active TER 0.70, passive TER 0.20, horizons 10/15/20.

request.description:
**Step 1:** Active gross 14.5% vs passive gross 14.0% with default TERs.
**Step 2:** Net returns: 14.5-0.7 = **13.8**, 14.0-0.2 = **13.8** -> net alpha 0.
**Step 3:** `breakEvenGrossOutperformancePercent` = **0.5**; all three horizons are **TIE**.

item.name: 4.2 Equal gross returns - passive wins on cost

request.description:
**Step 1:** Both gross 14%.
**Step 2:** Active net 13.3% < passive net 13.8%; passive wins every horizon.
**Step 3:** `corpusDifference` (active - passive) is negative and grows larger with horizon; `activeExpenseDrag` > `passiveExpenseDrag`.

**Step 1:** Active gross 16% vs passive 14%.
**Step 2:** Net alpha = 15.3 - 13.8 = **1.5%**; ACTIVE wins and the 20y corpus gap is the largest.

**Step 1:** Override TERs (active 1.0, passive 0.1) and horizons [12, 8].
**Step 2:** Horizons are returned sorted (8, 12) and TERs echoed back.

item.name: 5. Risk Metrics
item.description: Module 5. Periodic returns are in PERCENT. Fund = exactly 2x benchmark so beta must be 2.0.

request.description:
**Step 1:** Send 12 monthly returns; the fund series is exactly twice the benchmark series.
**Step 2:** Expect **200**.
**Step 3:** `beta` = **2.0** (Cov/Var), `observations` = 12, `riskFreeRatePercent` = **6.5** (default from application.yml).
**Step 4:** Fund volatility ~ 2 x benchmark volatility.
**Step 5:** `sharpeRatio` = (annualised return - 6.5%) / volatility - verified in the script.
**Step 6:** Jensen's alpha is returned as a number.

item.name: 5.2 Identical series - beta 1, alpha 0, custom Rf

request.description:

item.name: 6. Glide Path (STP)
item.description: Module 6. Equity is moved to debt in equal monthly STP instalments during the final X years.

item.name: 6.1 15y goal, 3y glide, 30% crash 12 months before goal

exec: pm.test('Equity allocation falls monotonically in glide', () => { for (let i=12;i<15;i++) pm.expect(j.glideSchedule[i].equityAllocationPercent).to.be.below(j.glideSchedule[i-1].equityAllocationPercent); });
pm.test('Crash impact is smaller for glide', () => pm.expect(j.glidePath.corpusImpactOfCrash).to.be.below(j.fullEquity.corpusImpactOfCrash));

request.description:
**Step 1:** Send the request (12% equity, 6.5% debt, 3-year glide, 30% crash 12 months before the goal).
**Step 2:** Expect **200**.
**Step 3:** `glideSchedule` has 15 rows: years 1-12 are ACCUMULATION at 100% equity; years 13-15 are GLIDE; year-15 equity allocation is **0%**.
**Step 4:** Without a crash, full-equity ends higher (`opportunityCostWithoutCrash` > 0).
**Step 5:** With the crash, glide ends higher (`crashProtectionBenefit` > 0).
**Step 6:** Invested amounts are identical in both strategies (SIP continues).

**Step 1:** Set `glideYears: 0`.
**Step 2:** Expect **200**; glide and full-equity outcomes are identical, `crashProtectionBenefit` = 0 and the schedule stays 100% equity.

**Step 1:** Send only `monthlyInvestment`, `equityReturnPercent`, `totalYears`.
**Step 2:** Expect **200** with defaults echoed: `glideYears` 3, `marketCrashPercent` 30, `crashMonthsBeforeGoal` 12.

**Step 1:** Stop new SIPs once the glide starts.
**Step 2:** Expect **200**; glide `totalInvested` = 10000 x 12 x 12 = **1,440,000**, less than the full-equity run (1,800,000).

**Step 1:** Glide window (6y) longer than horizon (5y).
**Step 2:** Expect **400** *Invalid input*: glideYears cannot exceed totalYears.
